DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teacher_onboarding_turn)
       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teacher_onboarding_interaction)
       OR EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM teacher_dialog_job
           WHERE coordinator_mode <> 'legacy'
              OR source_message_version IS NOT NULL
              OR reply_to_message_id IS NOT NULL
              OR response_assistant_ui IS NOT NULL
              OR response_assistant_ui_digest IS NOT NULL
       ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'cannot remove S5 coordinator schema after use';
    END IF;
END $$;

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teacher_dialog_turn_outcome WHERE no_effect_proof_id IS NOT NULL) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'cannot remove S5 coordinator schema after no-effect delivery evidence exists';
    END IF;
END $$;

-- These are the four foreign-key constraints introduced by 019.  They are
-- deliberately removed before their owned tables; 017's proof/outcome FKs
-- remain intact because a 019 rollback returns to the post-018 schema.
ALTER TABLE teacher_onboarding_turn
    DROP CONSTRAINT teacher_onboarding_turn_interaction_receipt_fk,
    DROP CONSTRAINT teacher_onboarding_turn_job_event_fk;

ALTER TABLE teacher_onboarding_interaction
    DROP CONSTRAINT teacher_onboarding_interaction_action_receipt_fk,
    DROP CONSTRAINT teacher_onboarding_interaction_reserved_job_fk;

ALTER TABLE teacher_dialog_turn_outcome
    DROP CONSTRAINT teacher_dialog_turn_outcome_proof_fk,
    DROP COLUMN no_effect_proof_id;

DROP TABLE teacher_onboarding_turn;
DROP TABLE teacher_onboarding_interaction;

ALTER TABLE teacher_dialog_job DROP CONSTRAINT teacher_dialog_job_shape_check;

ALTER TABLE teacher_dialog_job
    ADD CONSTRAINT teacher_dialog_job_shape_check
        CHECK (
            (status = 'queued' AND decision_id IS NULL AND response_body IS NULL AND delivered_message_id IS NULL AND delivered_at IS NULL AND terminal_outcome IS NULL AND reconciliation_state IS NULL)
            OR (status = 'processing' AND delivered_message_id IS NULL AND delivered_at IS NULL AND terminal_outcome IS NULL AND reconciliation_state IS NULL AND ((decision_id IS NULL AND response_body IS NULL) OR (decision_id IS NOT NULL AND response_body IS NOT NULL)))
            OR (status = 'delivery_pending' AND decision_id IS NOT NULL AND response_body IS NOT NULL AND delivered_message_id IS NULL AND delivered_at IS NULL AND terminal_outcome IS NULL AND reconciliation_state IS NULL)
            OR (status = 'delivered' AND decision_id IS NOT NULL AND response_body IS NULL AND delivered_message_id IS NOT NULL AND (teacher_turn_schema_version = 1 OR teacher_response_message_id IS NOT NULL) AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND error_code IS NULL AND (terminal_outcome IS NULL OR terminal_outcome = 'delivered') AND reconciliation_state IS NULL)
            OR (status = 'completed' AND response_body IS NULL AND delivered_message_id IS NULL AND teacher_response_message_id IS NULL AND delivered_at IS NULL AND terminal_outcome = 'failed_no_effect' AND reconciliation_state IS NULL AND no_effect_proof_id IS NOT NULL AND recoverable_outcome_id IS NOT NULL AND error_code IS NOT NULL)
            OR (status = 'blocked' AND response_body IS NULL AND delivered_at IS NULL AND error_code IS NOT NULL AND terminal_outcome IS NULL AND ((delivered_message_id IS NULL AND teacher_response_message_id IS NULL) OR (reconciliation_state = 'committed_unreconciled' AND delivered_message_id IS NOT NULL AND teacher_response_message_id = delivered_message_id)))
        );

ALTER TABLE teacher_dialog_job
    DROP CONSTRAINT teacher_dialog_job_response_assistant_ui_ck,
    DROP CONSTRAINT teacher_dialog_job_coordinator_mode_ck,
    DROP CONSTRAINT teacher_dialog_job_source_message_version_ck,
    DROP COLUMN response_assistant_ui_digest,
    DROP COLUMN response_assistant_ui,
    DROP COLUMN coordinator_mode,
    DROP COLUMN reply_to_message_id,
    DROP COLUMN source_message_version;
